newsitem.title: USA: Super-majority tax bill advances in South Carolina.
newsitem.headline: Super-majority tax bill advances in South Carolina.

text.p: The South Carolina House of Representatives has approved a constitutional amendment requiring two-thirds approval by the Legislature for tax increases, state officials said.
The House approved the measure 88-32 on Wednesday. It still must be approved by the Senate and then by voters in a referendum, in order to become part of the state constitution.

Separately, the House approved another bill requiring two-thirds approval in the Legislature for tax increases. Because that one is not a consitutitional amendment, it would require only Senate approval and the governor's signature to become law.
Republicans, who hold a majority in the House, made the super-majority requirement a part of their fall campaign platform.
